reviews.author: Photo of Tia Thorpe
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience! The atmosphere was so serene and relaxing from the moment I walked in. Ashley was incredibly sweet, welcoming, and made me feel comfortable throughout the entire appointment. The Brazilian wax was done with great care and was much less painful than I expected. She was professional, gentle, and efficient. I highly recommend Ashley if you’re looking for a great waxing experience. I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Photo of Tiffany Griffin
reviews.text: I went to visit Ashley today for a Brazilian! I hadn't had one in few years and decided to treat myself. Ashley was amazing made me feel super comfortable about everything! She did a great job and took her time. The office is super clean and very inviting! I highly recommend for any of your needs, if I could rate 10 stars I would!! Thanks Ashley! 💚

reviews.author: Photo of Andrea Hill
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Ashley. Her space is clean and inviting. Although I haven’t had a wax in a while, she made me feel very comfortable and at ease. Will highly recommend her to anyone needing waxing and facial services!!

reviews.author: Photo of Bristol Larson
reviews.text: Ashley was incredible! I scheduled her mobile phlebotomy services after I had multiple failed lab draw attempts. She communicated well, showed up on time and got my draw completed on her first attempt! I was so impressed and would highly recommend her to anyone!

reviews.author: Photo of Julia B
reviews.text:
Absolutely wonderful!
This was my first facial but I knew I was in good hands!!
Ashley is extremely knowledgeable, highly skilled and can help guide or answer any questions.
Her office is calm and welcoming. She gave me professional recommendations with different options to suite my needs!
Highly recommend ❤️
